snippet.title: Magnavale: Eternal Soul - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Eternal Soul is a gothic Metroidvania where you steal the souls of your enemies. Explore the castle, find powerful items & abilities, fight against demonic creatures, and learn the truth of your power.

Eternal Soul is meant to bring together the fun ideas from the various IGAvanias into a single game for Castlevania fans to enjoy. Such as the "rush-souls" from Aria & Dawn, or the bilateral dashing from Harmony. With many quality of life additions/adjustments, new castle, and new mechanics.

This isn't yet another parry-vania, or souls-like. Just the classic IGAvania combat and movement style we all love.

So, for all of you out there who are tired of Konami making collections and pachinko machines, this is for you!

Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3704270/Magnavale_Eternal_Soul/
X/Twitter: https://x.com/BarrierStudios
